Rule-text SHA256: `7e23e6fb9db43d0600fca75356da773133e7ea02b5ea8d104f2e08f7e6110aea`; normalized rule hash `8022db4c5a5f`.

Checked seed 17, sample indices 0–99 separately for easy/medium/hard: 300 draws,
300 globally distinct generated inputs, and 294 overlapping two-demo-plus-query
windows (98 per band). The tool also replayed all three canonical pairs. There
were 0/300 validator rejections, 0/300 Python/Racket disagreements, 0/294 rejected
or ambiguous lessons under the declared rival/hook checks, and 0/3 canonical
mismatches or validator rejections.

The observed operation copies left-half nonzero cells to reflected right-half
positions while retaining source cells and permitted right-side distractors.
The checked default lessons exposed the intended source-selection behavior. This
is bounded evidence, not universal approval or proof against unknown shortcuts.
All override combinations and every named scene profile were not exhaustively
swept by this audit. Destination collisions excluded by the documented generator
are a domain boundary, not a reproduced label defect.

`checks/audits/32a376372541-samples.jsonl`, and the empty
`checks/audits/32a376372541-lesson-failures.jsonl`.
